correctness.rationale: Every disconnected triple in K_n minus a spanning cycle is exactly a three-term cyclic arc; barycentric orbit coordinates give an exact PL fixed-complex model. Its minimal quotient edges are the two endpoint pairs and interior triples. The complementary-facet union splits into two contractible pieces with intersection Y_{m−2}; the suspension recurrence and explicit bases Y_3,Y_4≃S^0 prove the integral homotopy formula for all n≥5. The packaged independent finite checker exercises all reflection types up to n=28 but is not used for all-n proof.

value.rationale: The exact geometric reflection-fixed homotopy type for an infinite, currently studied family is not determined by its published ordinary homotopy classification or cyclic homology characters. The proof also yields a structural two-vertex suspension recurrence for a natural two-ended truncated interval hypergraph, and distinguishes the two even-order reflection-axis types.
